items.text: Wezwa amazwi amadodana kaLabani, ethi: “UJakobe wathatha konke okwakungokukababa; futhi kulokho okwakungokukababa wathola lonke lolu dumo.
UJakobe wabona ubuso bukaLabani, bheka, babungenjengakuqala kuye.
UJehova wayesethi kuJakobe: “Buyela ezweni lawoyihlo nasezihlotsheni zakho; futhi ngizoba nawe.
UJakobe wathumela wabiza uRaheli noLeya endle emhlambini wakhe.
Wathi kubo: “Ngiyabubona ubuso bukayihlo ukuthi kabunjengakuqala kimi; kepha uNkulunkulu kababa wayenami.
Niyazi nina ukuthi ngamkhonza uyihlo ngawo onke amandla ami;
Uyihlo wangikhohlisa, waguqula inkokhelo yami kayishumi; kodwa uNkulunkulu kamvumelanga ukuthi angilimaze.
Uma esho njalo ukuthi: Ezimanakanaka ziyakuba ngumvuzo wenu; zonke izinkomo zazigqoka ezimanakanaka; futhi uma esho kanje: Ezinemishwe ziyakuba ngumvuzo wenu; zonke izinkomo zinemishwe.
Ngakho uNkulunkulu wazithatha izinkomo zikayihlo wanginika zona.
Ngesikhathi umhlambi ukhulelwa, ngaphakamisa amehlo ami, ngabona ephusheni, bheka, izinqama ezikhwela umhlambi zazimthende, nezimanakanaka, nezimaqamu.
Ingelosi kaNkulunkulu yasikhuluma kimi ngephupho, yathi: “Jakobe; ngathi: Nangu mina.”
Yasisithi: Phakamisa amehlo akho, ubone, zonke izinqama ezikhwela umhlambi zimthende, ezilamabala, nezingamaqamu, ngokuba ngikubonile konke uLabani akwenzayo kuwe.
NginguNkulunkulu waseBethele, lapho wagcoba khona itshe lesikhumbuzo, nalapho wenza isithembiso kimi; vuka manje, uphume kuleli zwe, ubuyele ezweni lokuzalwa kwakho.
Base bephendula oRaheli noLeya, bathi kuye: “Sisenesabelo nefa endlini kababa na?”
Asibalwa njengabafokazi kuye na? ngokuba usithengisile, wadla nemali yethu.
Ngokuba yonke ingcebo uNkulunkulu ayithatha kubaba ingeyethu neyabantwana bethu; khona-ke yenza manje konke uNkulunkulu akutshele khona.
UJakobe wasukuma, wakhwelisa amadodana akhe nabafazi bakhe emakameleni;
Wathatha zonke imfuyo yakhe nayo yonke impahla yakhe abeyizuzile, imfuyo abeyizuzile ayeyizuzile ePhadani Aramu ukuze aye kuyise u-Isaka ezweni laseKhanani.
ULabani wahamba ukuyogunda izimvu zakhe, uRaheli weba izithombe zikayise.
UJakobe wamfihla uLabani umAramu engazi, ngokungamtshelanga ukuthi uyabaleka.
Wabaleka nakho konke anakho; wasuka, wawela umfula, wabhekisa ubuso bakhe ezintabeni zakwaGileyadi.
Kwathi ngosuku lwesithathu uLabani watshelwa ukuthi uJakobe ubalekile.
Wathatha abafowabo, bamxosha ibanga lezinsuku eziyisikhombisa; bamfica ezintabeni zakwaGileyadi.
UNkulunkulu wayesefika kuLabani umAramu ephusheni ebusuku, wathi kuye: “Ziqaphele ukuba ungakhulumi okuhle noma okubi kuJakobe.”
ULabani wamfica uJakobe. UJakobe wamisa itende lakhe entabeni, uLabani nabafowabo bamisa entabeni yaseGileyadi.
ULabani wasesithi kuJakobe: Wenzeni ukuthi ungebele ngokungazi, wathumba amadodakazi ami ekuthunjweni ngenkemba?
Ubalekeleni ngasese wangeba; awushongo kimi ukuthi bengiyakumukisa ngentokozo, nangezihlabelelo, nangetamale, nangehange?
Awungivumelanga ukuba ngange amadodana ami namadodakazi ami na? wenze into ewubuwula nje.
Kusemandleni esandla sami ukukulimaza; kodwa uNkulunkulu kayihlo ukhulume kimi izolo ebusuku, wathi: Ziqaphele, ungakhulumi okuhle kumbe okubi kuJakobe.
Manje, noma wawufuna ukuhamba, ngokuba wawulangazelela indlu kayihlo, webeleni onkulunkulu bami na?
UJakobe waphendula, wathi kuLabani: “Ngokuba ngesaba, ngokuba ngathi: Mhlawumbe uyakungiphuca amadodakazi akho.”
Lowo othola kuye onkulunkulu bakho, ungamvumeli aphile. Ngoba uJakobe wayengazi ukuthi uRaheli wayezebile.
ULabani wangena etendeni likaJakobe, nasetendeni likaLeya nasematendeni ezincekukazi ezimbili; kodwa kabatholanga. Waphuma etendeni likaLeya, wangena etendeni likaRaheli.
URaheli wathatha izithombe, wazifaka empahleni wekamela, wahlala phezu kwazo. ULabani waphenya itende lonke, akalitholanga.
Wathi kuyise: “Mayingathukutheli inkosi yami ukuthi ngingenakusukuma phambi kwakho; ngoba umkhuba wabesifazane uphezu kwami. Wacinga, kepha akazitholanga izithombe.
UJakobe wathukuthela, wamhlupha uLabani; uJakobe waphendula, wathi kuLabani: “Siyini isiphambeko sami na?” isono sami siyini ukuba ungizingele kangaka na?
Lapho usuhlolisisile zonke izinto zami, utholeni kuzo zonke izimpahla zendlu yakho? yibeke lapha phambi kwabafowethu nabafowenu, ukuze bahlulele phakathi kwethu sobabili.
Le minyaka engamashumi amabili benginawe; izimvukazi zakho nezimbuzi zakho aziphunzanga, nezinqama zomhlambi wakho angizidlanga.
Okudwengulwe ezilwaneni angikulethanga; ngikuthwalele ukulahlekelwa yikho; Wayibiza esandleni sami, noma yebiwe emini noma ebusuku.
Nganginjalo; ukoma kwangidla emini nesithwathwa ebusuku; ubuthongo bami basuka emehlweni ami.

Ngibe neminyaka engamashumi amabili endlini yakho; Ngakukhonza iminyaka eyishumi nane ngenxa yamadodakazi akho amabili neminyaka eyisithupha ngenxa yezinkomo zakho; futhi uwuguqule iholo lami izikhathi eziyishumi.
Uma uNkulunkulu kababa, uNkulunkulu ka-Abrahama, nokwesaba kuka-Isaka, wayengenami, ngabe ungimukise ngize. UNkulunkulu ulubonile usizi lwami nomsebenzi wezandla zami futhi wakusola izolo ebusuku.

ULabani wasephendula wathi kuJakobe: Lawa amadodakazi angamadodakazi ami, labantwana bangabantwana bami, lezinkomo ziyinkomo zami, lakho konke okubonayo kungokwami; ngingenzani lawa madodakazi ami lamuhla kubantwana bawo abawazalayo?
Woza-ke, senze isivumelwano, mina lawe; futhi makube ngufakazi phakathi kwami nawe.
UJakobe wathatha itshe, walimisa laba yinsika.
UJakobe wayesethi kubafowabo: “Buthani amatshe; bathatha amatshe, benza inqwaba; badla khona phezu kwenqwaba.
ULabani wayibiza ngokuthi iJegarisahadutha, kepha uJakobe wayibiza ngokuthi iGaledi.
Wayesethi uLabani: “Lelithemba namuhla liwubufakazi phakathi kwami nawe.” Ngalokho igama lawo lathiwa iGaledi;
neMispa; ngoba wathi: INkosi iyalinda phakathi kwami lawe, nxa singekho omunye.
Uma ucindezela amadodakazi ami, noma uthatha abanye abafazi ngaphandle kwamadodakazi ami, akukho muntu onathi; bheka, uNkulunkulu ungufakazi phakathi kwami nawe.
ULabani wayesethi kuJakobe: “Nanti leli themba, nali itshe lesikhumbuzo engiliphonse phakathi kwami nawe;
Lelithemba libe ngufakazi, futhi lelitshe lesikhumbuzo libe ngufakazi, ukuthi ngeke ngidlulisele lelithemba kini, nokuthi aniyikudiliza lelithemba naleli tshe lesikhumbuzo ukuze ngenze umonakalo.
UNkulunkulu ka-Abrahama noNkulunkulu kaNahori, uNkulunkulu kayise wabo, makahlulele phakathi kwethu. UJakobe wafunga ngokwesaba kukayise u-Isaka.
UJakobe wenza umhlatshelo entabeni, wabiza abafowabo ukuba badle isinkwa; badla isinkwa, bahlala entabeni ubusuku bonke.
ULabani wavuka ekuseni kakhulu, wanga amadodana akhe namadodakazi akhe, wawabusisa; uLabani wahamba, wabuyela endaweni yakhe.
